reasons: Range uses fixed window [5m]; the converter may only use [$__rate_interval], so the translation violates the hard rules.
Avg is taken over all device_major/device_minor series per image, not over containers. Datadog averages per-container values, so the averaged set differs.
The operation="read" matcher is a constant filter that is not in the Datadog source; the Datadog query reads all bytes for the image.
Grouping by container_image_name matches the observed dataset label and the Datadog docker_image grouping, so grouping is ok.
Whether docker.io.read_bytes is a cumulative counter or a rate needs confirming before rate() is applied; if it is a gauge of bytes, rate() is not allowed.
Because the range and filter are not allowed, the outcome should be re-derived by the converter, not accepted as translated.
